launches.title: Hickory: AI-native compliance operating system for banks and fintechs
launches.tagline: Replace legacy financial crime software with agent-first fraud and AML workflows
launches.body:
[Hickory](https://hickory.co) is an AI-native transaction monitoring and case management system for banks and fintechs. We replace legacy financial crime software with agent-first fraud and AML workflows.

Before Hickory, I was the founder of [Seis (W22)](https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/seis), a fintech that grew to over $10M in revenue in 15 months. We also built enterprise software for banks like Bank of America and Capital One, and led compliance at sponsor and community banks. We saw a major growth bottleneck for banks first-hand: manual compliance workflows, and clunky, stagnant compliance software. 

It isn’t just bad, it’s expensive. A small community bank spends $350k on monitoring, $150k on fraud, $120k on identity, $90k on audit and risk management and then another $1-2M on the team to run manual work clicking around cumbersome software. New AI companies promise to replace teams with agents, but then the banks still pay for legacy platforms. 

We built an operating system for compliance at banks and fintechs, where the compliance team can work directly with agents to accomplish their job. Automated workflows run in the background to gather evidence, pre-draft documentation, and recommend decisions. All of this tied to a knowledge base built by our expert compliance team. 

And the best part: it replaces bank’s and fintech’s expensive monitoring, fraud, and governance systems. 

* Teams process the queue 10x faster in a chat instead of a dashboard.
* BSA and compliance have direct access to reporting instead of waiting on an IT ticket.
* All evidence and reasoning is captured with a clear audit trail for examiners and auditors.
* Teams resolve manual work quickly and get more bandwidth for analysis and strategy.

If this is your world, I’d love to talk.

Book a demo at [hickory.co](http://hickory.co)
